description: Archives built byte by byte by generate.mjs, with stored entries: valid ones, and invalid ones that each break one rule.

cases.description: A schema-1 archive: the baseline the other cases change.
Readers sort the assets by path; the manifest's order does not matter.
A digest in upper case is read and reported in lower case.
A backslash in a manifest path is read as a slash.
Directory entries (names ending in /) are skipped.
An archive comment is allowed.
Schema 2: b.txt shares the stored content of a.txt through contentPath.
The three cache modes by name.
One leading UTF-8 byte order mark before the manifest is ignored.
A ZIP64 end of central directory record and locator, with the classic end record's fields at their markers.
ZIP64 extra fields hold every entry's sizes and offset, the classic fields at their markers.
Bytes before the first entry, such as a self-extracting stub, with offsets from the start of the file.
A length of -0 has no fraction and no exponent part: it is 0.
U+180E and U+200B are not white space (Unicode White_Space), so a path may start and end with them.
An unsupported version.
No version member.
The manifest is not JSON.
No runic-assets.json.
No assets.
contentPath in a schema-1 manifest.
contentPath names an asset that has a contentPath itself: the named asset must have its own entry.
contentPath names an asset of another length.
An asset with contentPath also has an entry, which is left over.
Two assets with the same path.
Two entry points.
No entry point.
A declared asset has no entry.
An entry under assets/ that the manifest does not declare.
An entry outside assets/.
Two entries with the same name.
The declared length differs from the entry's.
The declared digest is another content's. A lazy reader does not check digests.
The digest is right and the entry's CRC-32 is wrong: rejected in both modes.
The manifest entry's CRC-32 is wrong.
A parent-directory segment.
A rooted path.
A percent-encoded octet.
A colon.
Cache modes are case-sensitive.
A number in place of a cache mode's name.
A list of cache modes.
A cache mode's name with surrounding whitespace.
13.0 has a fraction part.
1.3e1 has an exponent.
A length in a string.
A blank media type.
A digest of 63 characters.
entryPoint in a string.
Two version members: duplicate member names are invalid, whichever comes last.
Two cacheMode members in one asset.
The manifest is not UTF-8: an unknown member's value has a lone continuation byte.
Not a ZIP archive.
Every entry has the encryption flag (bit 0) although its data is plain.
An entry count of 0xFFFF in the end record without a ZIP64 end record.
Bytes before the first entry, with offsets counted from the first entry instead of the start of the file.
a.txt has compression method 12 (BZip2): readers read methods 0 and 8 only.
a.txt's deflate data has the reserved block type 3, so it does not inflate.
a.txt's deflate stream ends inside its stored block.
a.txt's complete deflate stream inflates to 12 bytes, whose CRC-32 and digest it records, not to its length 13.
a.txt is stored with 12 bytes of data, whose CRC-32 and digest it records, and an uncompressed size of 13, its length.
A negative length.
A path that starts with U+00A0, which is white space.
A media type that ends in U+3000, which is white space.
A path with a lone surrogate escape.
